Soojin — I reviewed the SOW draft and left inline comments on two areas: data retention and encryption-at-rest/KMS language. Summary of proposed edits: 
- Data retention clause: change retention window to 90 days for session-level logs and 365 days for aggregated audit logs (we can make this configurable in the SOW appendix).
- KMS phrasing: tighten language to be explicit that customers may supply their own KMS and that Redwood will support BYOK via standard interfaces; remove broad language about key custody.

I do not see any deal-stoppers; these are standard and Sophie’s team should be fine with the wording. Once you accept the edits I'll produce a clean SOW for DocuSign routing.
